title: modelcontextprotocol/servers
title_zh: 模型上下文协议服务器

paragraphs.en: This repository is a collection of reference implementations for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), as well as references to community-built servers and additional resources.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库是模型上下文协议（MCP）的参考实现集合，同时包含社区构建的服务器及其他资源的引用。

paragraphs.en: If you are looking for a list of MCP servers, you can browse published servers on the MCP Registry . The repository served by this README is dedicated to housing just the small number of reference servers maintained by the MCP steering group.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你在寻找 MCP 服务器的列表，可以在 MCP Registry 上浏览已发布的服务器。 本 README 所对应的仓库专门用于存放由 MCP 指导小组维护的少量参考服务器。

sents.en: If you are looking for a list of MCP servers, you can browse published servers on the MCP Registry .
sents.zh: 如果你在寻找 MCP 服务器的列表，可以在 MCP Registry 上浏览已发布的服务器。

sents.en: The repository served by this README is dedicated to housing just the small number of reference servers maintained by the MCP steering group.
sents.zh: 本 README 所对应的仓库专门用于存放由 MCP 指导小组维护的少量参考服务器。

paragraphs.en: The servers in this repository are intended as reference implementations to demonstrate MCP features and SDK usage. They are meant to serve as educational examples for developers building their own MCP servers, not as production-ready solutions. Developers should evaluate their own security requirements and implement appropriate safeguards based on their specific threat model and use case.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库中的服务器旨在作为参考实现，用于演示 MCP 的各项功能及 SDK 的使用方法。 它们是面向开发者的教学示例，帮助开发者构建自己的 MCP 服务器，而非生产就绪的解决方案。 开发者应根据自身特定的威胁模型和使用场景，评估自己的安全需求，并实施适当的安全防护措施。

sents.en: The servers in this repository are intended as reference implementations to demonstrate MCP features and SDK usage.
sents.zh: 本仓库中的服务器旨在作为参考实现，用于演示 MCP 的各项功能及 SDK 的使用方法。

sents.en: They are meant to serve as educational examples for developers building their own MCP servers, not as production-ready solutions.
sents.zh: 它们是面向开发者的教学示例，帮助开发者构建自己的 MCP 服务器，而非生产就绪的解决方案。

sents.en: Developers should evaluate their own security requirements and implement appropriate safeguards based on their specific threat model and use case.
sents.zh: 开发者应根据自身特定的威胁模型和使用场景，评估自己的安全需求，并实施适当的安全防护措施。

paragraphs.en: The servers in this repository showcase the versatility and extensibility of MCP, demonstrating how it can be used to give Large Language Models (LLMs) secure, controlled access to tools and data sources. Typically, each MCP server is implemented with an MCP SDK:
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库中的服务器展示了 MCP 的多功能性和可扩展性，演示了如何使用它为大语言模型（LLM）提供对工具和数据源的安全、受控的访问。 通常，每个 MCP 服务器都是使用 MCP SDK 实现的：

sents.en: The servers in this repository showcase the versatility and extensibility of MCP, demonstrating how it can be used to give Large Language Models (LLMs) secure, controlled access to tools and data sources.

paragraphs.en: These servers aim to demonstrate MCP features and the official SDKs.
paragraphs.zh: 这些服务器旨在演示 MCP 的功能和官方 SDK。

paragraphs.en: The following reference servers are now archived and can be found at servers-archived .
paragraphs.zh: 以下参考服务器现已归档，可在 servers-archived 中找到。

paragraphs.en: TypeScript-based servers in this repository can be used directly with npx .
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库中基于 TypeScript 的服务器可以直接通过 npx 使用。

paragraphs.en: For example, this will start the Memory server:
paragraphs.zh: 例如，这将启动 Memory 服务器：

paragraphs.en: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory Python-based servers in this repository can be used directly with uvx or pip . uvx is recommended for ease of use and setup.
paragraphs.zh: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory 本仓库中基于 Python 的服务器可以直接通过 uvx 或 pip 使用。为便于使用和配置，推荐使用 uvx。

paragraphs.en: For example, this will start the Git server:
paragraphs.zh: 例如，这将启动 Git 服务器：

paragraphs.en: # With uvx uvx mcp-server-git # With pip pip install mcp-server-git python -m mcp_server_git Follow these instructions to install uv / uvx and these to install pip .
paragraphs.zh: # 使用 uvx uvx mcp-server-git # 使用 pip pip install mcp-server-git python -m mcp_server_git 按照这些说明安装 uv / uvx，并按照这些说明安装 pip。

sents.en: However, running a server on its own isn't very useful, and should instead be configured into an MCP client.
sents.zh: 但是，单独运行服务器本身并没有太大用处，而应该将其配置到 MCP 客户端中使用。

sents.en: For example, here's the Claude Desktop configuration to use the above server:
sents.zh: 例如，以下是使用上述服务器的 Claude Desktop 配置：

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "memory" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory " ] } } } On Windows, wrap npx with cmd /c :
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "memory" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory " ] } } } 在 Windows 上，需要用 cmd /c 包裹 npx：

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "memory" : { "command" : " cmd " , "args" : [ " /c " , " npx " , " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory " ] } } } Additional examples of using the Claude Desktop as an MCP client might look like:
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "memory" : { "command" : " cmd " , "args" : [ " /c " , " npx " , " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory " ] } } } 将 Claude Desktop 作为 MCP 客户端使用的其他示例可能如下所示：

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "filesystem" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem " , " /path/to/allowed/files " ] }, "git" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " mcp-server-git " , " --repository " , " path/to/git/repo " ] }, "github" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-github " ], "env" : { "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN" : " <YOUR_TOKEN> " } }, "postgres" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres " , " postgresql://localhost/mydb " ] } } } On Windows, apply the same wrapper to each npx -based entry above by changing "command" to "cmd" and prepending "/c", "npx" to the existing args . Leave uvx entries unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "filesystem" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem " , " /path/to/allowed/files " ] }, "git" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " mcp-server-git " , " --repository " , " path/to/git/repo " ] }, "github" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-github " ], "env" : { "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN" : " <YOUR_TOKEN> " } }, "postgres" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres " , " postgresql://localhost/mydb " ] } } } 在 Windows 上，对上面每个基于 npx 的条目应用相同的包装方式：把 "command" 改为 "cmd"，并在现有 args 前面加上 "/c" 和 "npx"。 uvx 条目保持不变。

sents.en: { "mcpServers" : { "filesystem" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem " , " /path/to/allowed/files " ] }, "git" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " mcp-server-git " , " --repository " , " path/to/git/repo " ] }, "github" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-github " ], "env" : { "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN" : " <YOUR_TOKEN> " } }, "postgres" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres " , " postgresql://localhost/mydb " ] } } } On Windows, apply the same wrapper to each npx -based entry above by changing "command" to "cmd" and prepending "/c", "npx" to the existing args .
sents.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "filesystem" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem " , " /path/to/allowed/files " ] }, "git" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " mcp-server-git " , " --repository " , " path/to/git/repo " ] }, "github" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-github " ], "env" : { "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN" : " <YOUR_TOKEN> " } }, "postgres" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres " , " postgresql://localhost/mydb " ] } } } 在 Windows 上，对上面每个基于 npx 的条目应用相同的包装方式：把 "command" 改为 "cmd"，并在现有 args 前面加上 "/c" 和 "npx"。

paragraphs.en: Interested in creating your own MCP server? Visit the official documentation at modelcontextprotocol.io for comprehensive guides, best practices, and technical details on implementing MCP servers.
paragraphs.zh: 有兴趣创建你自己的 MCP 服务器吗？ 请访问官方文档 modelcontextprotocol.io，获取关于实现 MCP 服务器的全面指南、最佳实践和技术细节。

sents.en: Interested in creating your own MCP server?
sents.zh: 有兴趣创建你自己的 MCP 服务器吗？

sents.en: Visit the official documentation at modelcontextprotocol.io for comprehensive guides, best practices, and technical details on implementing MCP servers.
sents.zh: 请访问官方文档 modelcontextprotocol.io，获取关于实现 MCP 服务器的全面指南、最佳实践和技术细节。

paragraphs.en: See ADDITIONAL.md for a curated list of frameworks and resources that simplify building MCP servers and clients.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 ADDITIONAL.md，其中整理了一份可简化 MCP 服务器和客户端构建工作的框架与资源列表。

paragraphs.en: See CONTRIBUTING.md for information about contributing to this repository.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md 了解为该仓库做出贡献的相关信息。

paragraphs.en: See RELEASING.md for how packages are published (OIDC trusted publishing from CI — no registry tokens) and how to retry a failed publish.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 RELEASING.md，了解包是如何发布的（使用来自 CI 的 OIDC 可信发布——无需 registry 令牌），以及如何重试失败的发布。

paragraphs.en: See SECURITY.md for reporting security vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 SECURITY.md 以报告安全漏洞。

paragraphs.en: If you find MCP servers useful, please consider starring the repository and contributing new servers or improvements!
paragraphs.zh: 如果您觉得 MCP 服务器有用，请考虑为仓库点星并贡献新的服务器或改进！

paragraphs.en: Managed by Anthropic, but built together with the community. The Model Context Protocol is open source and we encourage everyone to contribute their own servers and improvements!
